scope: Windows native debug binary, dev opt-level 1/dependencies 3, RTX 4070 SUPER/Vulkan, 1280x720 HDR/bloom, playback-only, seeded high-tier tuned smoke, twelve host rockets, explicit benchmark budget 24 owners (default host has no ceiling). Two distinct binaries, no compilation concurrent with native runs. Ordinary and instrumented lanes are separate. GPU scopes are asynchronous and nested; do not sum them. No production-finale or photographic acceptance.

runs.name: baseline-profile

selected_lighting.scope: Asynchronous native adapter capacity/dispatch metadata, not live or illuminated particle counts. No selected-position readback.

encoding_ledger.scope: CPU command encoding only; asynchronous latest frame, no GPU completion fence or visible-pixel assertion. Stateful quantization up to one simulation tick is expected.

runs.phase_scope: Main-world observation phase: launch-and-overlap until final host detonation; active-fireworks while a non-smoke emitter is alive or unobserved; smoke-drain while only retained smoke/tail owners remain; idle after owner retirement. Counts are asynchronous; boundary intervals are tagged at observation, not GPU execution.
